scenario.job: morning museum visit, hotel break, same-day afternoon return

admission.entry_time_basis: Selected entry time helps the museum plan arrivals; visitors may stay all day.

standard_admission.currency_basis: editorial interpretation of dollar symbol at US venue

transaction_fee.basis: Official general-admission description says price will include this fee; do not add it twice to a later inclusive quote.

admission.refunds: non-refundable; transfer to another date subject to availability
admission.discounts: discount or membership cannot be applied after purchase

hours.general_pattern: Wednesday-Monday 09:00-16:00; closed Tuesdays; first Saturday opens 10:00
hours.limitations: Ticketing warns hours may change. Yearless holiday dates on the Visit page are not used as a 2026 calendar. Some spaces may close briefly midday for staff lunch breaks; this is not a museum closure or return policy.

method: Ordinary public homepage/Visit/Visitor Information/ticketing/linked general-admission store and Complete Details dialog. No date or quantity selected, cart addition, purchase, contact, account, hidden API or alternate-origin bypass. Tracking parameters removed from retained source URL.
result: PRESERVE public re-entry/rest uncertainty. All-day stay validity does not establish permission to leave and return or whether a second ticket is needed.
confidence: High for displayed general-admission validity, amount, fee and transfer conditions; unresolved re-entry, future-date availability, taxes, exact family checkout, route and actual rest feasibility.
next_gate: Explicit current official exit/re-entry rule or separately authorized human evidence before any same-admission hotel-break claim. Candidate budget integration must separately preserve per-person/transaction units, age basis, exceptions, currency interpretation, source date, unknown taxes and no checkout/date promise.
next_falsification_trigger: Changed public admission or explicit return policy; not an unchanged replay or a cadence-only rewrite.
